narrative:
Allen County has 64,071 registered voters, with 55.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 19.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.7% of registrants.
